sequence.description: Ceddanne Rafaela grounds into a force out, shortstop Mookie Betts to second baseman Tommy Edman. Nick Sogard out at 2nd. Ceddanne Rafaela to 1st.
Wilyer Abreu singles on a sharp ground ball to center fielder Andy Pages. Ceddanne Rafaela to 2nd.
Willson Contreras lines out to left fielder Teoscar Hernández.
Masataka Yoshida singles on a ground ball to left fielder Teoscar Hernández. Ceddanne Rafaela scores. Wilyer Abreu to 2nd.
Caleb Durbin singles on a line drive to center fielder Andy Pages. Wilyer Abreu scores. Masataka Yoshida to 3rd.
Shohei Ohtani singles on a sharp line drive to right fielder Wilyer Abreu.
Freddie Freeman grounds out to first baseman Willson Contreras.
